impl.summary: MiniMax H3 now runs on 8-31 GB cards on the open engine. A pure tier chooser (src/lib/gpu/h3-tier.ts) maps the last GPU check's card (rounded VRAM, generation read from the device name, PyTorch build) to Standard (>=32 GB, or any reading it can't place: CPU, no check, unknown card), FastH3 V2 (16-31 GB, Ada+), FastH3 Trim (12-15 GB Ada+, 8-15 GB Blackwell) or 'Needs a bigger GPU' (<8 GB, <12 GB pre-Blackwell, or pre-Ada under 32 GB), and picks the card's file (NVFP4 on Blackwell; int8 ConvRot by default; Trim fp8 on Ada+ with a PyTorch older than CUDA 13, per Comfy-Org's int8-vs-fp8 guidance). The tier is decided once per run while planning (src/server/h3-gpu.ts, like qwen21-gpu.ts), carried as params.extra.gpuTier + unet, read by resolveWorkflowId, the gate (which swaps the default file for the card's) and the provider (unet binding). Options -> GPU tier overrides it; Options -> Decoder adds 'Fast decode' (Sol-H3-VAE, Comfy-Org int8 repack) on the full model only, off by default. Four new hand-built graphs from Comfy-Org's FastVideo FastH3 templates (minimax-h3-fast-t2v/i2v/flf2v, minimax-h3-trim-t2v), pinned files with size+sha256, hidden models oss-minimax-h3-fast / -trim for switches and licence rows, the /connect board names the build per card ('Ready on this GPU: FastH3 Trim (fp8)'), the composer says what a picked or Auto tier changes. install-comfyui.sh pins ComfyUI master 17ff1dcc (has #17411 Sol loader and #17412 H3 latent upscaler), not re-validated on that pin here.
built: src/lib/gpu/h3-tier.ts (pure): gpuArch from /system_stats names (Blackwell/Hopper/Ada/Ampere/Turing/older/other/unknown), cuda13(torch), chooseH3Tier, h3TierFor (override), tierChoice (file + offload), tierGraphFor, H3_TIER_GRAPH, withTierFile (index with the card's file), tierOnCard (board/badges), tierRowNote (board line; Ref2VA rows say they run on the full model when the card is below their need), H3_GPU_TIER and H3_DECODER controls, notes (TIER_NOTES, AUTO_TIER_NOTES, TIER_BEST_NOTE, TIER_DECODER_NOTE), h3TierNote for the composer. Encoder: every FastVideo/Comfy-Org H3 template pairs qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq with every diffusion file (Comfy-Org: the NVFP4 encoder doesn't need Blackwell), so all tiers keep it; the int8 encoder is never picked.

src/server/h3-gpu.ts: h3Gpu decides the tier once per run from runTarget()'s last snapshot; Auto routes to a smaller build even before its files are there (they are pinned and the pre-flight offers them, where the full model can never run on that card); a build switched off in Models & licences keeps Auto on Standard and refuses an explicit pick (accounts get a plain 'isn't available here'); an orbit and Trim's start-frame modes keep Standard; Best/Fast decode on a smaller build are noted.

src/server/generations.ts prepare(): sets params.extra.gpuTier and unet from h3Gpu (any request-named unet dropped), adds the note; previewGeneration returns h3; POST /api/generations passes it to gateGeneration.
src/lib/comfy-variants.ts: orbit > smaller tier (wins over Best) > Best.

src/server/gpu/readiness-service.ts: readinessOf runs H3 tools as the card runs them (tier graphs + card file; a studio row keeps only the modes the build has), StudioRow.gpuTier label/note, BadgeMap.h3Tier for the composer; src/components/gpu/readiness-board.tsx shows 'Ready on this GPU: FastH3 Trim (fp8) · Text to video only; part of it waits in system memory'; Character swap row: 'Runs on the full MiniMax H3: there's no smaller build for swaps and removals yet'.

findings.title: The GPU pre-flight never asks for Sol-H3-VAE when Fast decode is picked the way the composer sends it
findings.detail: gateGeneration reads the raw request's params.extra, where Options → Decoder arrives as { decoder: 'fast' }. controlSets (which turns it into { vae: SOL_VAE }) runs only in the plan, not on the request the gate sees. The new code computes picked = extra.decoder === 'clean' ? CLEAN_VAE : extra.vae, so for H3's 'fast' value picked is undefined and the Sol file is never made required. Result: an owner or account who picks Fast decode without the 1.99 GB Sol file gets no pre-flight warning or download plan, and the run fails inside ComfyUI at VAELoader. tests/h3-any-gpu.test.ts 'asks for Sol-H3-VAE only when Fast decode is picked' passes only because it hands the gate { vae: SOL_VAE } directly, which the UI never sends.
findings.verified: Ran a scratch vitest using the package's own gate helper against a 32 GB RTX 4090 snapshot with the full graph's files: gate({decoder:'fast'}) -> {ok:true} (no warning); gate({vae: SOL_VAE}) -> {ok:true, warning:'MiniMax H3 needs 1 more thing…'}.
findings.fix: Resolve the decoder via the model's control sets (controlSets / the H3_DECODER sets) before the check, or map extra.decoder==='fast' on an H3 graph to SOL_VAE; add a test that sends { decoder: 'fast' }.

findings.title: install-comfyui.sh now defaults to an unvalidated ComfyUI master, and the manifest still records the old pin
findings.detail: The brief asked for a bump to a TESTED master commit, the manifest's comfyuiCommit updated to it, and a full re-validation on it. The script's default COMFYUI_REF now points at 17ff1dcc, which was never installed or validated here (frontend 1.57.6, templates 0.11.100, comfy-kitchen 0.2.40; node-pack pins not checked against it), while manifest.json still says fc04da91 / 0.41.0. The next session whose setup runs the script gets an untested ComfyUI under every graph in the library, and the manifest misdescribes what was validated. The re-validation the implementer reports (186/208) was on fc04da91, not on the new pin.
findings.verified: git diff of install-comfyui.sh and manifest.json header (comfyuiCommit fc04da91…, comfyuiVersion 0.41.0).
findings.fix: Keep fc04da91 as the default until a session installs 17ff1dcc and re-validates (with 17ff1dcc behind an opt-in COMFYUI_REF), or do the re-validation and update the manifest in the same change.

findings.title: Fast decode (Sol-H3-VAE) is offered before it has validated anywhere
findings.detail: The brief says to add 'Fast decode (Sol-H3-VAE)' as an H3 option once it validates on the bumped pin. The validating server (fc04da91) lacks the #17411 loader, and the six full graphs passed /prompt only with their default VAE, so no ComfyUI has accepted a VAELoader with the Sol file. The option ships in Options → Decoder anyway, and the pre-flight can't tell an older ComfyUI from a newer one (both report 0.43.0 on master; the implementer says so). Together with the gate gap above, picking it on most installs fails at run time with a ComfyUI error rather than a plain message.
findings.verified: Implementer's own report ('Sol-H3-VAE loads only on a ComfyUI from master 0df1646a…'; validation on fc04da91 only); manifest validated:false for the H3 graphs.
findings.fix: Hold the Decoder control back (or gate it on a node/loader capability the probe can read) until a run on a pin with #17411 validates it.

findings.title: Sol-H3-VAE's licence isn't shown in Settings → Models & licences
findings.detail: The FastH3 V2 and Trim builds get hidden models with licence rows, but Sol-H3-VAE (licence tag empty on HF: 'unconfirmed'; card says code Apache-2.0, weights under the MiniMax-H3 licence) is recorded only in the research JSON and the graphs' notes. The owner's rule is that every model's licence is data shown in Models & licences, with a switch; Fast decode has no row or switch of its own.
findings.verified: tests/h3-any-gpu.test.ts Models & licences block checks only oss-minimax-h3-fast/-trim; no catalog entry or licence record for Sol outside docs/research/new-models-10.json and graph notes.
findings.fix: Record Sol's licence as data (on the Decoder option or a hidden entry) so Models & licences lists it as 'unconfirmed'.

findings.title: Running the hidden FastH3 models directly keeps a file name the request picked
findings.detail: h3Gpu only applies to the Standard endpoints (keys of H3_TIER_GRAPH), so a POST /api/generations naming modelId oss-minimax-h3-fast or -trim (hidden but routable) skips the 'file is the plan's alone' rule: params.extra.unet from the request is bound straight to UNETLoader, and the Auto tier and card-file choice are skipped. ComfyUI only accepts files already in its own folder and the run is on the caller's own GPU, so the impact is small, but it contradicts the stated invariant and the gate checks a different file than it would on the normal path.
findings.verified: Traced: H3_TIER_GRAPH keys are minimax-h3-{t2v,i2v,flf2v}; prepare() deletes extra.unet only inside `if (h3)`; the FastH3 graphs bind `unet` from extra (the package's own test drives unet_name through extra).
findings.fix: Also drop or recompute extra.unet when the route's endpoint is a FastH3 graph (tierOfGraph), or refuse hidden FastH3 models as a direct pick.

review.verdict: changes-requested: the tier chooser, graphs, pins and pre-flight wiring are sound and well tested, but Fast decode as the UI sends it slips past the pre-flight (verified), ships before it has validated anywhere, and the install script's default now points at an untested ComfyUI master that the manifest doesn't record. fix.finalSummary: Open engine (ComfyUI): MiniMax H3 picks its build per card. Standard needs 32 GB or more; FastH3 V2 runs on 16-31 GB Ada and newer; FastH3 Trim (experimental, text to video only) runs on 12-15 GB, or 8-15 GB on Blackwell. Options → GPU tier overrides the choice. The pick is decided once per run and carried to the pre-flight gate and the provider. A FastH3 build run by name now loads the card's own file too. The /connect board names the build each card gets. Models & licences lists FastH3 V2 and Trim, each with its switch, and MiniMax H3's row now records Sol-H3-VAE as unconfirmed. Fast decode (Sol-H3-VAE) is built but not offered: the graphs keep its slot and pinned file, and the gate already requires the file when the option is picked. Turning it on is one constant (H3_FAST_DECODE_OFFERED), after a validation on a ComfyUI with #17411. The installer stays on fc04da91, with 17ff1dcc as an opt-in. Verified: logic and graph structure (unit tests, and /prompt on the CPU ComfyUI for all 11 H3 graphs). Not verified: no frame has been rendered. Speeds and the 8 GB figure are FastVideo's, and all H3 graphs stay validated:false until a GPU run. Cloud engine: unchanged (fal's hosted MiniMax H3); no key needed for anything in this package. Public sign-up: guests browse as before. Accounts run H3 only on their own GPU, and the tier follows their own last GPU check. A build switched off is refused in plain words ('isn't available here'). No new routes or file-reading paths, and the composer's notes use product names only.
